## Problem

Describe who is affected and what they need to do.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how the feature would work and what it would improve for users.

## Acceptance Criteria

List the observable outcomes that would show the feature solves the problem. Include any important error or edge cases.

## Additional Context (Optional)

Include relevant screenshots, design references, technical considerations or related issues.
